name: Dr. Md. Saiful Islam Moon
about:
Dr. Md. Saiful Islam Moon was all along a scholar in his student life- both in school, college and medical college. He passed MBBS from Mymensingh Medical College in 2006 in regular session. Soon after his graduation, Dr Moon joined Lab Aid Dhanmondi, then Ibn Sina Medical College Hospital, and before completing post-graduation, he was ICU in charge for 10 years at Delta Medical College Hospital, Mirpur 1. He took post-graduation training in medicine and cardiology from Dhaka Medical College Hospital and Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College and Hospital. He obtained his Master's Degree (MD) in Nephrology from Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University (BSMMU). He served in different Medical College with utmost sincerity, honesty and excellence. He began his Nephrology career at BRB HOSPITALS LIMITED as a Specialist in Nephrology under Professor Dr Md. Nizam Uddin Chowdhury who is a renowned kidney specialist in Bangladesh and President of the Bangladesh Renal Association. He was promoted to Junior Consultant Nephrology on 1 August 2023 for his merits and sincerity. Dr. Moon has publications, which include Original articles, Review Articles, case reports, etc.
Dr. Moon's areas of expertise are: 
1. Short-term and chronic kidney disease (AKI and CKD)
2. Hypertension management
3. Kidney-related infection, kidney stones.
4. Electrolyte abnormalities (like sodium, potassium, others).
5. Post Kidney transplantation follow-up.
6. Complications related to post-kidney transplantation.
7. Temporary or permanent hemodialysis catheter insertion and complications management.
8. Peritoneal dialysis catheter insertion.
9. Renal biopsy.
10. Complications related to dialysis.
11. Kidney complications due to diabetes and hypertension.

about: Dr. Shaikh Mominul Haque Rakib, physician at Kidney Foundation Hospital and Research Institute, Dhaka is a multifaceted medical professional known for his expertise and compassionate care. With a comprehensive educational background encompassing an MBBS degree, MCGP certification, PGT training, CCD accreditation, and an MPH qualification, Dr. Rakib is equipped to address a diverse range of medical needs. Specializing trained in nephrology and dialysis, Dr. Rakib adeptly manages conditions such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), acute kidney injury (AKI), and nephrotic syndrome, Kidney Transplant. Additionally, he provides specialized care for patients with diabetes mellitus (DM), hypertension (HTN), thyroid disease, and allergic conditions. His proficiency extends to treating arthritis, gout, urticaria, and other allergic diseases, ensuring comprehensive care for his patients. Dr. Rakib's commitment to patient well-being is further exemplified by his certification in CPR training from the American Heart Association. This training underscores his dedication to emergency preparedness and ensures that he can respond effectively to critical situations, thereby enhancing patient safety.

Dr. Majidur Rahman has undergone extensive training in various specialized areas including osteopathic manipulative medicine, Advanced Mechanical Correction Therapy (Spine & Peripheral), Infiltration, Dry needling, and Clubfoot management (Ponseti method). His expertise spans across musculoskeletal (Orthopedic) and sports-related issues, where he specializes in pain management, paralysis, arthritis, and sports injuries. He possesses the capability to manage physiotherapy emergencies in critical care units like ICU, NICU, and CCU.

As a testament to his involvement in the field, Dr. Rahman serves as the treasurer of the Bangladesh Physiotherapy Association (BPA- Dhaka Division).

His professional journey includes serving as a former Senior Clinical Physiotherapist at CRP, primarily specializing in the Musculoskeletal and Sports Injury Unit for more than 7 years. He possesses remarkable knowledge and skills in musculoskeletal (orthopedic) and sports injury-related issues, coupled with the ability to manage physiotherapy emergencies in critical care units like ICU, NICU, and CCU.
Dr. Md. A. N. Rajib has contributed significantly to his field with several articles published in reputed international journals, focusing on chronic low back pain, lumbar spondylolisthesis, cervical radiculopathy, and core stabilization exercises. His experimental article on anaerobic strength training and spinal cord lesion was recently presented at the international Conference Combined ISSICON-ASCon 2022, held in New Delhi, India.
In October 2022, he joined Enam Medical College & Hospital in the Department of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation as a Senior Physiotherapy Officer, bringing his wealth of experience and expertise to the institution.

Dr. Nujhat has accrued significant experience in physiotherapy since 2014 and held the position of Senior Clinical Physiotherapist at the Centre for the Rehabilitation of the Paralysed (CRP) Savar, specializing in neurology for nearly 7.4 years.

Her areas of expertise include pain management, arthritis, paralysis, sports injuries, women’s health, gynecology, and neurology. Additionally, she possesses the skills to handle patients and manage physiotherapy emergencies in critical care units like ICU, NICU, and CCU.

name: Dr. Sania Ahsan
about:
Dr. Sania Ahsan's educational journey began with her graduation from Dhaka Medical College in 1994. In 1996, she embarked on her career as an honorary Medical Officer in the Department of Radiology at Dhaka Medical College Hospital. From 1996 to 2003, she served as a Medical Officer at BIRDEM Hospital. During this period, she also pursued further studies, earning her M. Phil in Radiology and Imaging from Dhaka University in 1999 and her FCPS from the College of Physicians and Surgeons, Bangladesh in 2004. Between 2003 and 2008, she held positions as an Assistant Professor and Associate Professor at BSMMU.

Dr. Ahsan boasts an impressive record of publications in various International and National Journals. She has also presented her research papers in both domestic and international seminars. One of her notable original research papers is titled "Developmental Abnormalities of Intracranial Dural Folds." Her professional interests particularly center around fetal MRI and stroke imaging.
Prior to her tenure at Evercare Hospital Dhaka, Dr. Sania Ahsan pursued further expertise by working as a Clinical Fellow in Pediatric Neuroradiology and Neuroradiology at the Hospital for Sick Children and Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre, University of Toronto, Canada, from 2010 to 2012.
For more information or to schedule an appointment, please contact us at: 09611 530 530.

name: Dr. Dilruba Yeasmin Dina
about:
Dr. Dilruba Yeasmin Deena is a distinguished Obstetrician, Gynaecologist, and Gynaecological Oncologist renowned in Bangladesh for her expertise. She completed her MBBS degree in 2001 from Chittagong Medical College and entered Government service through the 24th BCS.

Her pursuit of excellence led her to achieve FCPS in Obstetrics & Gynaecology in January 2010 and FCPS in Gynaecological Oncology in January 2021 from Bangladesh College of Physicians and Surgeons (BCPS).

Dr. Deena specializes in managing both invasive and pre-invasive diseases of the female genital tract. Her expertise lies in surgically treating women with ovarian cancer, cervical cancer, endometrial cancer, vulval cancer, and vaginal cancer. She employs the latest evidence-based, clinically-proven techniques to ensure the best possible outcomes for her patients.

She currently treats her patients at Popular Diagnostic Centre Ltd. in Savar, Dhaka Central Diagnostic & Imaging Center and Bangladesh Specialized Hospital in Shyamoli, Dhaka.

name: Dr. Monira Zaman Tanvee
about:
Throughout the internship, the Dr. Monira Zaman Tanvee gained expertise in various medical procedures, including intravenous access, nasogastric tube placement, managing status epilepticus, acute severe asthma attacks, diabetic ketoacidosis, myocardial infarction and angina, as well as shock, particularly hypovolemic, cardiac, and septic shock. She also provided assistance in endotracheal intubation and foley catheterization. During this period, the intern learned to navigate the bottom of the totem pole and maintain a tight schedule, while finding the emergency duties to be rewarding.
Dr. Monira Zaman Tanvee served at Keraniganj Upazila Health Complex for community service in Dhaka-1310, where she had the opportunity to encounter various medical conditions and learn how to handle different emergency situations. Additionally, during two weeks of community service, she acquired valuable knowledge and experience.

After obtaining her FCPS in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery from the Bangladesh College of Physicians and Surgeons in 2012, she became an Associate Professor at Sapporo Dental College & Hospital in Uttara, Dhaka.
Dr. Luna has received specialized training in Implant Dentistry, Facial Deformity, and Oral Reconstruction Surgery in South Korea, Japan, and Sri Lanka. She is a skilled Oral Surgeon who performs surgeries on the mouth, jaws, and related head and neck structures, including difficult and multiple tooth extractions, tumor removal, and jaw revision surgery.
Dr. Luna is also experienced in performing minor cosmetic procedures such as chin and cheek-bone enhancements and minor facial rejuvenation procedures. Additionally, she provides emergency treatment for facial injuries and is skilled in the removal of tumors and other abnormal growths in the oral and facial regions.
She has a particular interest in the Dredging Method, a conservative surgical procedure for odontogenic tumors, and is highly experienced in cleft lip and palate repair surgery, crown and bridgework of teeth, cosmetic dentistry, and dental implants.

To further enhance her knowledge, she also obtained membership (MRCS) from the Royal College of Surgeons in the UK.
Dr. Tarafder has gained extensive experience and expertise in General Surgery, with a particular focus on Breast and Colorectal diseases, hernia, and laparoscopic surgery. She aims to modernize surgical practices in Bangladesh by incorporating the latest diagnostic and surgical/nonsurgical disease management protocols. She keeps herself updated by attending international seminars and training courses to maintain international standards. She excelled in the training course for breast disease management at the Department of Endocrine Surgery at Christian Medical College (CMC) in Vellore, India.
Dr. Tarafder is a lifelong member of several professional organizations, including the Association of Breast Surgeons of Bangladesh (ABSB), Asian Society of Mastology (ASOMA), and Society of Laparoscopic Surgeons of Bangladesh (SLSB).

She began her career at Chittagong Medical College before relocating to Saudi Arabia. She worked at Medina Maternity & Children Hospital and King Faisal Military Hospital until 2006 before joining Square Hospital, where she currently works as a consultant.

Dr. Mirza participated in a fellowship program on minimal invasive surgery at World Laparoscopy Hospital in New Delhi and received the FMAS fellowship. She also received hands-on training in sutureless vaginal hysterectomy from Purohit General Hospital in Orissa, India, and total laparoscopic hysterectomy from Sunrise Hospital in Delhi, India. She received advanced training in laparoscopic hysterectomy and myomectomy from K. K. Women’s & Children Hospital in Singapore. With over 25 years of experience in obstetrics and gynecology, she has established a strong foundation of knowledge and skills in her field.

about:
